theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_finite_parallel_planes
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Z : Set (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → Module.finrank ℝ V = n → Z ⊆ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ w ∈ Z, ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ a w) → ν = Measure.sum (fun w : Z => a w • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V}) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ν (ball 0 R) ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n)) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < ν (ball 0 r)) → ∃ (N : ℕ) (w : Fin N → Euclid P) (α : Fin N → ℝ), Injective w ∧ (∀ i, w i ∈ Vᗮ) ∧ (∀ i, c ≤ α i) ∧ ∑ i, α i ≤ 1 ∧ (∃ i, w i = 0) ∧ ν = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (α i) • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w i ∈ V}
